newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Wee Poh public share offer 101 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Wee Poh public share offer 101 times subscribed.

text.p: Infrastructure company Wee Poh Holdings Ltd's initial public offer (IPO) was 101 times subscribed, state television said on Thursday.
Wee Poh launched a 24.8 million share IPO priced at Singapore $0.45 each on November 18.
Its placement tranche of 6.2 million shares was fully taken up. Of the public offer of 18.6 million shares, 6.2 million were reserved for staff and business associates.
Wee Poh said the net proceeds of S$7.5 million would be used for buying equipment, redeveloping an existing building to house the group's operations and for working capital.
The shares will start trading on a when-issued basis on Monday.
